title.narrative: Food Security and Climate Resilience in Disaster Affected areas

description.narrative:
This is a nexus project envisages to address the food insercurity problems through the implementaiton of climate change adaptation, nutrition sensitive agriculture and disaster risk management interventions in five conflict and disaster affected communities in Afar, Amhara, Oromia, Somali and Tigray regions. The consortium lead is Action Against Hunger - USA in partnership with other implementing partners; Denmark Refugee Council and International Rescue Committee.
The project addresse climate change adaptation through the implementation of disaster risk reduction and mitigation interventions such as natural resources management, promotion/introduction of climate smart technologies. Gender equality is addressed as cross cutting under respective relevant programme components eg. crop production, value chain development etc. The programme design looks into specific needs of men and women in the context of the programme themes enabling both genders benefit from various programme interventions.
